name: QUINCENTRA
source:
In a distant future where humanity has transcended flesh, Syntia and Nexor have lived through centuries together—until everything falls apart. 

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/quincentra-english]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的未来，人类已经超越了肉体，辛提亚和内克索一起度过了几个世纪——直到一切崩溃。

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/quincentra-english]itch.io[/url]]
